verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so MCP-client support is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP servers or plugging in external tool servers. The plugin system (the Excalidraw canvas example, page API) is a different extension mechanism. The '20+ programming tools' claim concerns which tools the plan works with, not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
